claims.assertion: Anéeka speculated invasive AI may use the Federation's muonic information network to coordinate and shape civilizations' perceptions.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She called this highly probable, not confirmed.

claims.speaker: Alenym
